Heron yields area²=s⁴(3−4z+4p)/16, z=(u+v)²,p=uv. Symbolically independently differentiated acute circumradius F_z(p) to exactly 2(1−z)(2p+1)(p+1−2z)/(3−4z+4p)². Min across acute/obtuse branches occurs at p=0,2z−1,z/4 in consecutive z ranges <=1/2,1/2..4/7,>=4/7; obtuse threshold cannot beat acute minimizer. Resulting f(k) strictly decreases to sqrt3/4, hence one crossing of h/k and r/f(k) yields all formulas and unique maximizing axial gaps. Boundary h=0, saturation h>=4r/sqrt3 checked. Finite symbolic checks support derivative and transition algebra, universal proof relies on monotonicity and enclosing-circle argument.
